data.one_liner: Streaming API for MessagePack binary serialization in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides Packer and Unpacker classes to pack and unpack data using the MessagePack format. Supports automatic unpacking of lists and maps via a streaming interface.
use_when: Need efficient binary serialization for custom protocols
avoid_when: Prefer JSON or other text formats
Require code‑generated models or schema validation
strengths: Works on all major Flutter platforms
weaknesses: Only supports MessagePack, no other formats
